review_candidates.description: About Vargent Systems Vargent Systems is building Metaldesk, a compliance platform for precious metals dealers in Europe. Two regulatory deadlines land in 2027. Spain’s Verifactu invoicing requirement (Real Decreto 1007/2023) applies to companies from 1 January 2027 and to self-employed professionals from 1 July 2027. The EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation, (EU) 2024/1624, applies directly in every member state from 10 July 2027, with no national transition period. Gold and precious metals dealers become obliged entities across the EU, subject to customer due diligence, a €10,000 cash payment ceiling, record retention and authority reporting. Roughly ten legally required steps sit behind a single counter purchase: identifying the seller, describing and photographing the item, recording measurements, pricing, exception approval, authority reporting, retention tracking, smelting batch records, settlement and reconciliation. Across Europe most dealers still do all of it on paper, after hours, from memory. We are building the software that makes those steps digital, verifiable and audit-ready as the purchase happens. The platform is in development against the 2027 deadlines. Vargent Systems was founded in 2026 and works across Helsinki, Barcelona and Milan. Three markets, three positions We are hiring one Account Executive for each of our first three markets: Finland (based in Helsinki), Spain (Barcelona or Madrid) and Italy (Milan). Tell us in your application which market you are applying for. You work in the language of your market. Each role starts roughly two months ahead of its market launch: Finland October 2026, Spain November 2026, Italy January 2027. The role You own your country. Metaldesk is sold to independent gold buyers, jewellers with buy-back counters, pawnbrokers, scrap gold dealers and precious metals wholesalers — small, independent businesses that are about to fall under a regulation they are not yet prepared for. Strong electronic identification is already standard at the counter. Spain: two deadlines, one buyer. Verifactu makes certified invoicing software mandatory from January 2027, and AMLR follows in July 2027. The invoicing tool a compraventa de oro has used for a decade stops being lawful. Italy: compro oro operators are already registered with OAM under D.Lgs. 92/2017 and report to the UIF. That register is also your prospect list, by name and address. That person owns their country’s regulatory rule set inside the platform — thresholds, identification methods, retention periods, report formats — tracks supervisory guidance and turns it into product requirements, monitors customer filings, and supports dealers in the local language. It suits someone with 3+ years in AML or regulatory compliance operations who wants to be customer-facing rather than writing policy. If that is you, apply here and say which market and which role.
